title: File:Frances (Appleton) Longfellow to Emmeline (Austin) Wadsworth, 7 July 1839 (c81b1e4a-7b57-40fc-8f34-e467680f28f2).jpg
desc:
Manuscript letter
Archives Number: 1011/002.001-009#006
Stockbridgiana- July 7th 1839.   
How & where art thou, sweetest, “ladye Emmeline”?  Comporting thyself with suburban, dust-tarnished shades – at that hotel of Gothic name Mrs A. writes you talk of inhabiting which sounds to me Mesopotamia-ish
